title: John S. Knight Journalism Fellowships
institution: John S. Knight Journalism Fellowships, Stanford University
about: Stanford's John S. Knight Journalism Fellowships opened applications for the 2027-28 class on 14 October. The deadline is 2 December 2026 at 1:00 p.m. Pacific time; late applications and extensions are not accepted. Applicants need five years of professional experience.
requirements: Five years of professional experience; student work or internships do not count
Online form, resume, work sample and contact details for three professional references
